title: Stroke MRI: ischemic lesions on DWI and ADC with expert-approved masks
description: Two brain MRIs of ischemic stroke from ISLES 2022 (diffusion-weighted images and ADC maps), each with the lesion mask approved by an attending neuroradiologist. Converted from the dataset's NIfTI (skull-stripped, 2 mm) to DICOM with the geometry taken from the NIfTI affine; DWI and ADC share one frame of reference.

referenceTargets.label: Ischemic stroke lesion (ISLES 2022 expert-approved mask)

provenanceDetail.method: Hybrid human-algorithm annotation (Hernandez Petzsche et al. 2022): a DWI-trained U-Net pre-segmentation corrected by trained annotators (DWI, ADC and FLAIR reviewed), revised by a neuroradiologist in training and approved by an attending neuroradiologist with more than 10 years of stroke imaging experience. The mask is on the DWI/ADC grid; traced per slice with skimage find_contours (0.5) into image_px [col, row].
provenanceDetail.note: 19 slices with lesion; mask volume 13.2 ml.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the ischemic lesion is referenced; the vessel occlusion, older lesions and other findings are not outlined. The dataset does not give the time since onset or the affected arterial territory.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: Moderate ischemic lesion (about 13 ml in the mask, one dominant component). Restricted diffusion: bright on DWI; check that it is dark on the ADC map.
